The web app is built and committed. Here's what's in `markdown-notes/`:

- **index.html** — Entry point with sidebar + split-pane layout, loads marked.js from CDN
- **style.css** — Dark sidebar, clean white editor/preview area, full markdown preview styling
- **app.js** — All logic: create/edit/delete notes, live preview, search by title+body, localStorage persistence, tab support

To try it: open `markdown-notes/index.html` in any browser. No build step needed.
